localChanges: Discovering Gunpowder, and later Combustion, now makes your existing Barracks obsolete, as in Civ1. They're removed from your cities and you're told so. Rebuilt Barracks cost 1 gold a turn after Gunpowder and 2 after Combustion (closes #184).
A Hydro Plant can now only be built in a city with a River or Mountains next to it, as in Civ1 (closes #290).
